sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its action on the metabolic processes and the respiratory organs. It is useful in cases of chronic wasting diseases and chronic respiratory disorders. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of anemia and malnutrition.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest.
sections.Extremities: Aching and lameness in the limbs. Heaviness in the legs.
